dialogues.speaker: Melies
dialogues.text: Well, how was it? My experimental style and "Special Lighting" are quite something, no?

choices.text: I was just getting into it!

response.speaker: Melies
response.text: Ha, I knew you were up to the job!

response.speaker: Melies
response.text: Filming action scenes clearly suits you like a suit.

response.speaker: Melies
response.text: Feel free to drop by the studio anytime during the Film Festival to carry on filming, and immerse yourself in the limelight!

response.speaker: Melies
response.text: I literally have an inexhaustible supply of film roll, so no matter how many cuts you want to film, be my guest!

choices.text: When will the film come out?

response.speaker: Melies
response.text: Hard to say, to be honest...

response.speaker: Melies
response.text: Even after you and your acting double have finished all the filming, I've then got to go through the whole process of editing, color grading, sound design, and more...

response.speaker: Melies
response.text: I'm not even sure if it'll all be done in time to start officially promoting it and put out a trailer.

response.speaker: Melies
response.text: But none of our work will have been wasted! Even if it all takes a day or two extra, when the film finally comes out, its quality will speak for itself!

response.speaker: Melies
response.text: So please, have patience, my good partner.

response.speaker: Melies
response.text: Goodbye for now. Remember, when you get some time on your hands, please do pop into the studio for a bit of filming!
